title: This Totally Free App Can Free Up Space on Your Mac

claims.claim: Purge is a totally free and open source app that shows what is taking up space on your hard drive.

evidence.quote: This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive
This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive and offers a few specific ways to free it up.

claims.claim: Purge contains no ads or upsells.

evidence.quote: There are no ads or upsells.
Even better: There are no ads or upsells.

claims.claim: Purge can delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27
Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Deleting Apple Intelligence offline models can free up over 10 GB of space.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright.

evidence.quote: Finally, Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright, so you can always recover them if something breaks.

claims.claim: Purge includes a tool for uninstalling apps along with their associated files such as settings and caches.

evidence.quote: Up next is a tool for uninstalling apps. Note that this doesn't just remove the application—it also removes every file associated with it, including your settings, caches, and anything the application downloaded.

claims.claim: Apple Intelligence offline models power features like notification summaries, writing suggestions, and Siri.

evidence.quote: Apple's most recent operating systems come preloaded with offline AI models, which power things like notification summaries, writing suggestions, and the new AI-powered Siri.

claims.claim: Apple provides a toggle in macOS 27 to disable Apple Intelligence features.

evidence.quote: Apple removed the toggle in macOS 27 that lets you disable them altogether.
